name: Junkie-Mini (Lucid Machines Fast Single-GPU Model — Built on Triune Architecture)
description: Junkie-Mini is the fast single-GPU training configuration for Lucid Machines' inaugural Junkie model on the Triune architecture (12L / 1024D / 4E + 1 Shared Expert, VectorisedGLA, CentroidSteer, 4096 context).
